newsitem.title: USA: Falcon backs analysts' Q4 EPS forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Falcon backs analysts' Q4 EPS forecasts.

text.p: Falcon Building Products Corp said it was "on track with analysts' estimates for the fourth quarter and the full year."
Analysts are projecting the building-products manufacturer to report fourth-quarter earnings of $0.38 per share, up from $0.22 in the year-ago period, according to the First Call consensus.
For the full year, the First Call consensus is for earnings of $1.40 per share, up from $1.10 in 1995.
